display.purpose: Hero headline; the featured perfume's name in a spotlight at 1.02 leading.

headline.purpose: Band titles (category names, discovery, finder, gift); scales up to clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem).

title.purpose: Product-card names; slider titles use Amiri 400 at 1.75rem.

tagline.purpose: A perfume's one-line sentence; scent-pyramid notes at 1.375rem.

body.purpose: Default Arabic text and button labels.

lead.purpose: Paragraph under a band title, 38-40ch, in Lead Smoke on light bands.

label.purpose: Nav, 'inspired by' lines, captions, legends, footer links (0.8125-0.9375rem).

latin-caps.purpose: Perfume Latin names and the MIDAD wordmark only; uppercase, tracked 0.18-0.34em.

data.purpose: Small Latin data: size captions, TOP/HEART/BASE, step numerals, cart count. The only place Latin digits appear.

shadows.name: bottle-cast
shadows.purpose: Filter on every drawn bottle on a stage; spotlights use 0 26px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.45).

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Cart drawer over a 50% ink scrim.

shadows.name: laid-paper
shadows.purpose: Physical objects drawn on a band: gift card, discovery box.

motion.name: ease-ink
motion.purpose: Object motion: bottle lift on card hover (500ms), discovery slot nudge (400ms).

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour and border state transitions on buttons, chips, slider buttons.

motion.name: duration-underline
motion.purpose: Gold nav underline drawn from the right.

motion.name: ink-line
motion.value: scroll-linked; reveals to 82% of viewport height; never rewinds
motion.purpose: The page's single authored motion; shown complete and static under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Wave and Ink Line
components.description: Signature: an ink band ending in a wave filled with the next band's colour, the gold ink line pressed along it and a spray-square mark at the crossing.

narrative.overview:
Midad treats a page the way a calligrapher treats a sheet: one continuous surface, written top to bottom in ink. The homepage is not a stack of banners; it is a single painted scroll. A fixed Midad frame (ink, ivory, smoke, sand) holds a sequence of full-bleed bands, and each band flows into the next through a soft wave filled with the next band's colour. Between the frame bands, each category gets its own perfume world, painted in that perfume's palette, texture and ingredients, so the page carries very different moods without ever breaking into separate boxes.

One gold ink line is written down the whole scroll as the visitor reads. It sways down a side gutter like a hand-held reed pen, presses heavier where it rides each wave across to the other side, and leaves a small gold square, the brand's spray mark, at each crossing. That line is the page's only authored motion; everything else is quiet.

The density is low and the voice restrained: large Amiri headlines, generous bands (64 to 96px of vertical padding), square-cornered controls, and gold used as a signature, never as a fill. Depth comes from light and material (lamp glow, marble, resin, silk, smoke) drawn procedurally, not from UI shadows.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous scroll of full-bleed bands joined by soft waves; no hard section edges.
Fixed brand frame plus per-perfume worlds that bring their own palette, texture, plinth, light and line-drawn ingredients.
A single gold reed-pen line as the only authored motion, with spray-square marks at wave crossings.
Square corners everywhere except pill chips; thin 1px borders do the structural work.
Arabic-first RTL typography: Amiri for display, Plex Arabic for text, Cinzel only for Latin caps, Montserrat only for Latin data.
Smoked-glass bottles drawn to the brand guide's real millimetre proportions; no stock photography.

rules.name: The Gold Signature Rule
rules.body: Gold covers at most 10% of any view. It marks (a line, a stamp, a ring, a numeral, one CTA on ink); it never paints a band, a card or a panel.

rules.name: The Readable World Rule
rules.body: A perfume palette may be anything, but its text may not be unreadable. `fg` must reach 4.5:1 on `bg` and `muted` 3:1, checked at render time; a failing value falls back to whichever of Midad Black or Parchment Ivory reads better. The accent button's label is resolved the same way.

rules.name: The Next-Band Wave Rule
rules.body: Every band ends in a soft wave filled with the next band's background colour, so the eye never meets a straight seam. Each divider uses a different wave shape; the page never repeats one.

rules.name: The Numerals Rule
rules.body: Arabic UI shows Arabic-Indic numerals (prices, sizes, counts, ml, character counters), formatted through the `ar-EG` locale. Latin digits appear only inside Montserrat data captions.

rules.name: The Guest Script Rule
rules.body: Latin never sets running text. Cinzel is caps-only for names; Montserrat is small data only, marked `dir="ltr"`. Everything a visitor reads as a sentence is Arabic.

rules.name: The RTL-First Rule
rules.body: Layout is authored in logical properties (start/end, inline) for RTL. The ink line begins on the right; slider "forward" moves visually left; ornaments in textured worlds stay on the visual (left) half so they never sit under text.

rules.name: The Flat Interface Rule
rules.body: Controls and cards never lift. Shadows belong to drawn objects resting in light, or to layers that truly overlay the page (dropdown, toast, drawer).

rules.name: The Painted Light Rule
rules.body: Atmosphere is procedural: gradients, SVG noise and line art, painted from the band's own palette. No raster backgrounds ship; textures stay off the text half.

dos: **Do** end every band in a wave filled with the next band's colour, and give each divider its own wave shape.
**Do** keep gold under 10% of any view: lines, stamps, rings, numerals, one CTA on ink.
**Do** let a perfume world bring its own `bg / surface / fg / muted / accent`, texture, plinth, light and ingredient drawings, and run its text colours through the contrast fallback.
**Do** use Arabic-Indic numerals in Arabic UI via the `ar-EG` formatter; reserve Latin digits for Montserrat data captions.
**Do** keep controls square with 1px hairlines; draw borders in `currentColor` so components inherit their world.
**Do** draw bottles with the guide's real proportions, and render atmosphere procedurally (gradients, SVG grain, line art).
**Do** ease object motion with the ink curve, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and respect reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** add a second authored motion; the ink line is the page's only one. Hover states change colour, borders, or nudge a bottle, nothing more.
**Don't** fill bands, cards or panels with gold, or use gold as body text on ivory.
**Don't** shadow cards, buttons or chips, or lift them on hover.
**Don't** separate bands with straight rules or hard colour cuts.
**Don't** set running text in Latin, or use Cinzel and Montserrat outside names and data.
**Don't** redraw, stretch, recolour or shadow the logo, and never place the spray pattern behind it.
**Don't** use cold blue light, glossy plastic, or red roses in any world's texture or imagery.
**Don't** put texture ornament under text; it stays on the visual half of a band.
